_doc: FEAT-314: inline retry rules, shared by tools/ci/probe_hosts.py (pipeline/retry.py) and pipeline/fetch.ps1. Retry only a call that got no answer (connect failure, timeout), HTTP 408, 429 or 5xx, or a 2xx with a bad body (Overpass busy). Never a 4xx, unless one_off_4xx lists it for that host. Wait waits_s[k] (the last one again past the end), at least Retry-After up to max_retry_after_s, plus or minus jitter. Every number is a cap: no layer retries without a bound.
